description: Lists the workspace's database connections: name, driver, environment tag (LOCAL, DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, PRODUCTION, …), whether it is read-only or open to agent writes, where its password comes from, and whether the driver is available. Hosts and users are shown only when the agent policy allows. Read-only.
